source.title: Code of Conduct — expectations and interpersonal conflicts
source.section: Code of Conduct expectations and interpersonal conflicts note
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 本课选读 37signals 行为准则对善意、尊重和直接反馈的要求，以及一般人际冲突与正式行为准则报告的区别。练习中的进度沟通场景为虚构；固定更新时间是练习者提出的协作方案，不是手册规定。
paragraphs: We expect all active 37signals employees and contractors to:
Assume good intentions. Approach work relationships defaulting to trust and positivity.
Work “in the open” and be open to teaching and learning from others.
Be respectful and empathetic, especially when it comes to differing viewpoints and experiences.
Gracefully accept constructive criticism and direct feedback, and offer feedback in the same spirit.

An important note: Most interpersonal conflicts do not rise to the level of a Code of Conduct report. If you find a colleague rude or difficult to work with, you should address that with your manager or better yet with that colleague directly. Code of Conduct reports are reserved for serious transgressions — illegal or egregiously unethical behavior.
translations: 我们期望所有在职的 37signals 员工和承包商做到：
秉持善意。处理工作关系时，默认彼此信任、保持积极。
在公开中工作，并愿意向他人学习，也愿意教导他人。
保持尊重和同理心，尤其是面对不同的观点和经历时。
得体地接受建设性批评和直接反馈，并以同样的态度提供反馈。
需要特别说明：大多数人际冲突都达不到行为准则报告的程度。如果你觉得同事粗鲁或难相处，应与经理沟通，或者更好的是直接和那位同事沟通。行为准则报告适用于严重违规——违法或极不道德的行为。

fullChapterParagraphs: We expect all active 37signals employees and contractors to:
Assume good intentions. Approach work relationships defaulting to trust and positivity.
Work “in the open” and be open to teaching and learning from others.
Be respectful and empathetic, especially when it comes to differing viewpoints and experiences.
Gracefully accept constructive criticism and direct feedback, and offer feedback in the same spirit.
We expect 37signals to be a healthy place for all staff. 37signals prohibits all forms of discrimination and harassment.

If you experience or witness something that violates our Code of Conduct, please report it to your manager or to your People Ops team via email or chat. All reports will be reviewed and investigated, and your confidentiality will be as protected as possible during the investigation.

If an employee is found to have violated our Code of Conduct, it will be permanently documented in their personnel file. Depending on the severity of the offense and the findings of the investigation, additional responses may include mandatory training, a formal reprimand, or termination. The reactive measures taken will be shared with the reporting employee when possible.
In extreme circumstances, you can report an incident anonymously. Anonymous complaints should be reserved for incidents in which you fear for your safety.

37signals prohibits retaliation against any 37signals employee who participates in a Code of Conduct report or investigation. If you believe you are being retaliated against, please contact the People Ops team.

An important note: Most interpersonal conflicts do not rise to the level of a Code of Conduct report. If you find a colleague rude or difficult to work with, you should address that with your manager or better yet with that colleague directly. Code of Conduct reports are reserved for serious transgressions — illegal or egregiously unethical behavior.

We respect everyone’s right to participate in political expression and activism, but we avoid having political debates on our internal communication systems. 37signals as a company also does not weigh in on politics publicly, outside of topics directly related to our business. You should be at peace with both of these stances.

The 37signals Code of Conduct is not meant to be a replacement for your EEO rights. You can pursue charges through 37signals channels and through EEOC channels simultaneously. Visit the EEOC website for more information about your employee rights.

notes.meaning: 秉持善意；先假设对方出于善意
notes.explain: 遇到沟通摩擦时，先不急着推断对方故意刁难。
notes.example: I’m assuming good intentions and asking directly about the repeated calls.

notes.explain: 直接表达影响时仍要尊重对方的观点和处境。
notes.example: Could we discuss this directly and respectfully?

notes.explain: 把具体行为及其影响当面说清楚，并以希望得到的方式给出反馈。
notes.example: I’d like to share direct feedback about the repeated calls.

notes.phrase: Most interpersonal conflicts do not rise to the level of a Code of Conduct report
notes.meaning: 大多数人际冲突都达不到正式行为准则报告的程度
notes.explain: 普通的相处困难应先直接沟通或与经理讨论；正式报告留给严重违规。

scenario.title: Addressing repeated progress calls directly and respectfully
english: A teammate calls Sarah several times a day to ask for routine progress updates while she is analyzing data.
Sarah assumes the teammate is trying to keep the project moving, but the calls interrupt her focus.
She gives direct feedback respectfully and proposes one written update at an agreed time, with earlier notice if a blocker comes up.
chinese: 一位同事每天打好几次电话，询问例行进度；Sarah 正在分析数据。
Sarah 先假设同事是想推动项目，但这些电话打断了她的专注。
她尊重地直接反馈，并提出在约定时间书面更新；若遇到阻碍则提前告知。

firstAttempt.prompt: 同事一天内多次打电话询问例行进度，打断了你的数据分析。请先按善意理解对方，再直接、尊重地说明影响，提出固定的书面更新时间，并说明遇到阻碍会提前告知。
firstAttempt.sample: I’m assuming good intentions, but the repeated calls interrupt my analysis and make it harder to focus. Could we agree on one written status update at 3 p.m. each day? I’ll flag any blocker sooner.
firstAttempt.rationale: 答案先表达善意假设，再说明具体影响、提出可执行的同步方案，并保留阻碍时提前沟通的安排。固定时间是本练习中的建议，不是手册规定。

words.example: I’m assuming good intentions and would like to talk about the repeated calls.
words.translation: 我先按善意理解，也想谈谈反复来电的问题。
words.note: 是一种处理工作关系的默认态度，不代表忽视实际影响。

words.example: I’d like to offer direct feedback about how the calls affect my focus.
words.translation: 我想直接反馈一下这些来电对我专注工作的影响。
words.note: 具体说明行为和影响，语气仍保持尊重。

words.example: We can address this interpersonal conflict directly.
words.translation: 我们可以直接处理这次人际摩擦。
words.note: 一般人际摩擦不自动等同于严重违规。

words.collocation: rise to the level of a report
words.example: Most interpersonal conflicts do not rise to the level of a Code of Conduct report.
words.translation: 大多数人际冲突都达不到行为准则报告的程度。
words.note: 来源将正式报告保留给违法或极不道德的严重行为。

structure.original: Gracefully accept constructive criticism and direct feedback, and offer feedback in the same spirit.
analysis: Gracefully accept 和 offer 是并列的祈使结构，分别提出接受和给出反馈的行为要求。
constructive criticism and direct feedback 是 accept 的并列宾语。
in the same spirit 指以同样尊重、建设性的态度提供反馈。
structure.transfer: I’m assuming good intentions, and I’d like to share direct feedback about the review comments. Could you point to one example that needs more detail?

rewrite.bad: Stop calling me. I’ll tell you when I have something.
rewrite.good: I’m assuming good intentions, but the repeated calls interrupt my analysis. Could we agree on one written update at 3 p.m.? I’ll flag any blocker sooner.
rewrite.translation: 我先按善意理解，不过反复来电打断了我的分析。我们能否约定下午三点书面更新一次？如果遇到阻碍，我会提前说明。
rewrite.pattern: I’m assuming good intentions, but [specific behavior] affects [work]. Could we agree on [practical next step]? I’ll [early communication].

cloze.prompt: I’m ___ good intentions, but the repeated calls interrupt my analysis.
cloze.why: assume good intentions 对应先不推定对方动机恶意。

cloze.prompt: Could we agree on one written status update at 3 p.m. each ___?
cloze.why: each day 说明练习中的固定更新时间频率。

cloze.prompt: I’ll flag any ___ sooner if it affects the delivery.
cloze.why: blocker 是会妨碍进度的实际问题；提前说明可以减少不确定性。

dictation.text: Assume good intentions. Approach work relationships defaulting to trust and positivity.
dictation.label: 听写 1 · 秉持善意
dictation.why: 听出 Assume good intentions，以及 defaulting to trust and positivity 对工作关系的描述。

dictation.text: Most interpersonal conflicts do not rise to the level of a Code of Conduct report.
dictation.label: 听写 2 · 一般冲突与正式报告
dictation.why: 注意 do not rise to the level of 表示“达不到……程度”；正式报告不是普通摩擦的默认做法。

apply.prompt: 同事的沟通方式让你不舒服，但不涉及严重违规。请说明你会先怎么做。
apply.sample: I’ll assume good intentions and address the issue directly and respectfully with my colleague.

translationPractice.prompt: 我先按善意理解，不过反复来电打断了我的分析。
translationPractice.answer: I’m assuming good intentions, but the repeated calls interrupt my analysis.
translationPractice.why: assume good intentions 表示先按善意理解；后半句指出具体行为和工作影响。

translationPractice.prompt: 我们能否约定每天下午三点书面更新一次进度？
translationPractice.answer: Could we agree on one written status update at 3 p.m. each day?
translationPractice.why: Could we… 礼貌提出方案；one written status update 提供明确而可预测的同步方式。

translationPractice.prompt: 如果遇到阻碍，我会提前说明。
translationPractice.why: flag a blocker 表示说明会影响进度的问题；sooner 表明不等到固定更新时间才告知。

choice.prompt: 同事频繁询问进度打断了你的工作。根据行为准则，哪种回应最合适？
options: Report the colleague immediately because any uncomfortable interaction is a Code of Conduct violation.
Assume good intentions, explain the impact respectfully, and address the issue directly with the colleague.
Ignore every request and refuse to provide any progress information.
choice.why: 手册建议秉持善意、尊重地提供直接反馈；一般人际冲突不自动构成正式报告。

output.prompt: 同事在文档评审中留下简短但让你困惑的批注。请用英文表达善意假设，直接说明你想澄清，并请对方给一个具体例子。
output.sample: I’m assuming good intentions, and I’d like to clarify one of the review comments. Could you point to a specific example that needs more detail?
check: 是否直接、尊重地说明需要澄清？
是否提出了具体且可回答的问题？
